_comment: Grid combat tunables. Per-part numbers live on each part's `grid` block in data/parts/; terrain numbers on each tile's `grid` block in data/terrain/tiles.json. The damage-type wheel is `effectiveness` in data/balance.json.
_pile_drop: Play-test 4: a pile is not guaranteed. Each enemy carries scrap with this chance (seeded, shown on its tag); only carriers drop a pile. Drones never carry. Player machines always burst into one.
_pierce_overshoot: Play-test 4: a piercing shot carries this many hexes past its range, at this percentage of its damage (rounded half up, at least 1).
_objectives: rout: destroy every enemy. defend: caches (immobile) on the board; survive `rounds` rounds or rout; every cache left pays out. salvage: piles on the board; collect `need` of them or rout. A destroyed player machine always bursts into a scrap pile; an enemy only if it carries scrap (`pile_drop_pct`).
_pylon: 013: the Sorting Gate's pylons (props). While one stands, the Sorter takes `enemy_kinds.sorter.pylon_armor` less from every hit.
_flue: 025: a furnace flue (tile `f`, its blast in the tile's grid block) blows at the start of every `flue_every`-th round.
_modifiers: 028: the yard's conditions a fight may roll (run.json `modifiers`). `range` is added to every shot and lob, `vent` to the crew's vent, `pile_mult` multiplies a pile's worth; LIVE WIRES lays `wire` tiles (2 a round to whatever starts on one).

dust.name: DUST STORM
dust.text: Dust over the yard: every shot and lob reaches 1 hex less.

wires.name: LIVE WIRES
wires.text: Cables down and sparking: 2 damage to whatever starts a round on one.

scrap_rain.name: SCRAP RAIN
scrap_rain.text: A cargo hauler spilled its load: every scrap pile is worth double.

heat_wave.name: HEAT WAVE
heat_wave.text: The furnaces are running: your machines vent 1 less heat a round.
